_note: Famous poems that the chinese-poetry corpus lacks, added in their commonly taught form. Each needs an attribution note in its close reading, because the corpus leaving them out usually means their authorship is disputed.

poems.author: 杜牧
poems.title: 清明
poems.text:
清明时节雨纷纷，路上行人欲断魂。
借问酒家何处有？牧童遥指杏花村。
poems.source: 《千家诗》; not in 全唐诗, attribution to 杜牧 is traditional but disputed

poems.author: 李白
poems.title: 夜宿山寺
poems.text:
危楼高百尺，手可摘星辰。
不敢高声语，恐惊天上人。
poems.source: Taught as 李白's; 全唐诗 does not include it under this title
